title: Monuments reshape the Wiltshire landscape
summary: Communities built ceremonial and burial monuments across the Stonehenge and Avebury landscapes over roughly two millennia. Stone circles were part of a wider setting of earthworks, routes and graves.

claims.text: Communities built ceremonial and burial monuments across the Stonehenge and Avebury landscapes over roughly two millennia. Stone circles were part of a wider setting of earthworks, routes and graves.
Combined landscape range; not the construction dates of the Stonehenge stones alone.

The combined landscape is broader than the familiar standing stones. Its long development supports comparisons of collective work and ritual practice without presenting every monument as contemporary.
